messages:
katie_sales: FYI — Meridian Bank POC kicks off Mon. They're insisting on BYO-KMS with HSM-backed keys and an 7x24 rotation window. Need a consolidated preflight checklist + rough cost delta for BYO vs Redwood-managed.

leo_solutions: Can we confirm required certs? Customer asked FIPS 140-2 Level 3 and mutual TLS for key provisioning.

sam_devops: @katie_sales who is the HSM vendor they plan to bring? CloudHSM, AzureKV HSM, or on-prem Thales?

katie_sales: They've said "CloudHSM-compatible" but legal wants to allow on-prem later. For POC they'll provide a CloudHSM tenant we can reach over peered VPC.

maria_security: Need to surface audit requirements: customer wants key usage logs pushed to their SIEM via syslog + HSM attestation reports weekly. Also confirm whether Redwood's audit chain ties to their CMK IDs.

alex_pricing: Quick note — BYO-KMS will add a per-tenant handshake fee + egress for key fetches. I'll draft two numbers: (1) minimal POC usage (test tokens) and (2) sustained throughput baseline (100 qps).

sam_devops: For the POC we should run a short load test. I'll prepare a playbook and a small rotation script. Example of rotation handshake we'll run:
```
# rotation-check.sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/keys/rotate \n  -d '{"cmk_id":"cmk-1234","nonce":"abc123"}'
```
We'll validate KDF outputs and SDK compatibility.

leo_solutions: Also need SOW language for fallback: if HSM latency spikes, route to Redwood-verified softkey variant (customer-approved) with explicit fallback SLA. Meridian wants zero surprises.

katie_sales: Legal is pushing for key access matrix in the SOW. @maria_security can you confirm what we can commit re: key material access (redwood engineers vs customer-only)?

maria_security: We can commit "no access to plaintext key material by Redwood staff" for BYO-HSM when using customer KEK. We can however run key-lifecycle ops via delegated APIs and provide attestation logs. Need legal to approve exact wording.

alex_pricing: Draft numbers attached: POC fixed fee $7k, BYO-HSM handshake fee $1.2k, per-GB egress estimate $0.09. For 100 qps sustained we'll need reserved capacity estimate: add $15k/month. I'll post spreadsheet link in channel.

katie_sales: Great. @sam_devops can you add the test vectors and a short checklist we can hand to customer ops? Need by EOD Thursday.

sam_devops: Will do. Checklist will include: VPC peering CIDRs, peering validation script, CA certs, CloudHSM partition ID, key policy sample. Example key policy snippet:
```
{
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/meridian-peering"},"Action":"kms:Encrypt"}]
}
```

devops-bot: Deploy job #playbook/hsm-handshake started by sam_devops — logs: <https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1234>

katie_sales: Perfect. If legal approves the access clause we'll send the SOW and pricing. Thanks team — I'll sync with Meridian tomorrow and update.

maria_security: I'll prepare attestation template and proposed SOW language. Ping me if Meridian asks for HSM vendor support matrix.

alex_pricing: I uploaded the spreadsheet: <https://go.redwood.ai/sales/meridian-byok-pricing>

sam_devops: Uploaded playbook and rotation test scripts to the repo. Link in DM.

katie_sales: Closing loop — target: have SOW + test plan ready by Fri COB. :thumbsup:
